notes.title: Crimson Gray 1.0.1
notes.content:
We just finished uploading a new version of the game that contains a few minor changes that fix things after the patch is applied:
 - The lower main menu items are now correct.
 - It should be easier to get the Completion achievement.

These changes will probably have no impact on you, but we hope they improve quality of life a little for those affected!

EDIT: Some users have reported gallery problems in this version. New players shouldn't have an issue, but if you had a problem with unseen content unlocking, you may want to do a complete reinstall.
